faqs.question: Can I view the cameras on my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure remote access so you can watch live and recorded footage securely from your phone or computer.

faqs.question: How many days of recording can I store?
faqs.answer: It depends on the number of cameras, resolution and storage size. We'll size the recorder and hard drives to match the retention period you need.

faqs.question: Do you do a site survey before installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We assess your premises to plan camera positions, coverage and cabling before quoting.
